name: SHAREHOLDER_W2_5_VERSIONED_PDP_POLICY_GUARD_SYNTHETIC_ONLY

trustedBundle.revision: positive strictly increasing integer, never reused and no activation rollback
trustedBundle.identity: SHA256 over domain-separated canonical bundle; hash is NOT a signature
trustedBundle.clock: injected trusted in-memory test clock (not production time authority)
trustedBundle.validity: not-before inclusive, expires-at exclusive (>= expiry denies)
trustedBundle.revocation: active registry state invalidates all issued leases immediately in single process

decisionBinding.interpretation: server-only wrapper echoes trusted policy lease with W1 Python simulator result
decisionBinding.attestation: NO CRYPTOGRAPHIC PDP SIGNATURE; not proof actual Python executed that policy version
consistencyChecks: after audit and before synthetic source
decisionBinding.publicResponse: BFF always denies synthetic decisions, never returns operational 200 or actual record

provenance.requestId: server-generated ephemeral UUID from W2.3 trusted internal envelope
provenance.fileAudit: unchanged W2.4 file-backed chain with requestId, phase, decision, reasonCode only
provenance.limitation: Policy revision trace is in-memory and NOT embedded in W2.4 persisted hash chain; production audit schema migration required
provenance.auditOrder: W2.4 audit record and in-memory version trace before source.read

proofScope.source: synthetic in-memory source counter only; no physical SQL read proof
proofScope.request: detached W2.3 NextRequest and Nest synthetic proof checks; not real Nest controller for W2.5
proofScope.twoOwners: two synthetic owners in same fake tenant
proofScope.positive: SIMULATED_ALLOW never means real operational permission
proofScope.rollback: not supported in offline registry; never reopen revoked revisions

prerequisitesForFutureOperationalWiring: Independent signed versioned policy artifacts and immutable publication authority
Signed PDP decision attestation binding exact revision, digest, epoch, requestId and rule set
Cross-process globally consistent distributed revision/revocation and trustworthy time
Durable signed audit of version metadata integrated with W2.4 schema under an independent anchor
Independent legal source, board, classification and permissions approval
Actual Next/Nest/AppModule wiring, SQL source-touch instrumentation, RLS/security review
Full release checks deferred per user request; explicit Merge/Deploy authorization
